title: FAIR-AL: A reproducible active-learning framework for auditing demographic query drift in feature-based ASD screening
description:
Reference implementation for the revision of manuscript CMPB-D-26-04362 (Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine).

FAIR-AL audits demographic query drift: the change in the protected- or proxy-group composition of the cohort an active-learning rule chooses to annotate, measured by a Total-Variation Q-Bias between the cumulative queried distribution and a target distribution. The package contains four acquisition families (uncertainty, Pareto, weighted scalarisation, constrained with entropy fallback), strong composition controls, an adapted FAL-CUR arm, the strict paired-comparison core and the table builders, together with the declared 514-comparison plan.

The code is released under Apache-2.0. Fourteen aggregate result CSVs (paired endpoint values and aggregate per-query trajectories) plus their schema and provenance are distributed as a separate release asset under CC BY 4.0. Neither licence extends to ABIDE or to any ABIDE-derived feature table, which remain subject to the ABIDE data-use terms and are not redistributed. Per-run result records, per-subject predictions and the Figure 1 source are not distributed.

This record is a software archive. It is not the article and it does not assert that the article is published.
